title: Marrow Creek: the first job's walk
intro: The career's first job (scout the Old farm), then on to the nearest way out, the Rail yard: 343 m from the truck, in the valley's reference weather (drizzle by day). Walked by the procedure in `docs/craft/WALK_REVIEW.md`; shots from `walk.stills`, stops from `stops.json`.

s01.vista: A farm track runs off the road into flat, misted meadow; three or four roofs float in the haze ahead, a woodpile by the verge. Grey, but it has depth.
s01.discover: An anomaly sparking in the grass right by the track, 10 m off; behind you the gate, the guard booth and the truck. The lamp on the ranger tower to the right.
s01.for: The drop: what's this place, and where do I go. The roofs ahead answer the second; the sparks answer the first.

s02.vista: The farm resolves: a barn and a house in the mist, a shed on a hummock to the right, a tower lamp on the left skyline.
s02.discover: The shed on its mound, close; the ranger tower's lamp and its stair. Something white glints by the far house.
s02.for: Walking toward the job with it in view; the shed is the first 'could go in there' for a newcomer.

s03.vista: The barn and house at a middle distance down a muddy track, pines behind. The best composed frame of the walk so far.
s03.discover: Side: the shed's ivy-covered back wall. Its door faces away from the track, so it reads as a box, not a room.
s03.for: Calm walking; the shed should be the small first discovery, and isn't, because its door is round the back.

s04.vista: At the fork the farmhouse with green shutters stands square ahead, the barn's wall filling the left; a proper farmyard frame.
s04.discover: Side: a jeep with a trailer, the ranger tower and a factory chimney with lamps on them both. Plenty to look at.
s04.for: Arrival at the farm: this frame is the job's real reveal, 15 m before the job's own point.

s05.vista: Arriving, you stand at the farmhouse's corner: its door and shuttered window close on the right, an empty slope and the mist on the left.
s05.discover: The door, close and plain. Side: the shed and jeep you passed, lamps on the skyline.
s05.for: 'You're there', the scout job's moment, and half of it works: the door says go in; the empty left half of the frame says nothing.

s06.vista: A cut through a bank with lamps and a mast beyond it: the way on, framed by the farmhouse's corner.
s06.discover: Side: the farmhouse's door and shuttered windows; the mast to the right.
s06.for: Leaving the farm: the gap in the bank is a good threshold.

s07.vista: A low wet hollow: puddle, rocks, a single tall spruce, sparks in the grass.
s07.discover: Side: the Hollow's anomalies (a burner's sparks, a purple disc), a concrete wall on the rise. It looks wrong, and you want to look closer.
s07.for: Tension: the danger-3 ground you skirt, seen, not entered.

s08.vista: The path climbs past poles toward roofs on the skyline (the depot), firs either side.
s08.discover: Side: back down into the Hollow, sparks and a steeple's lamp beyond. A bird lifting.
s08.for: Leaving the danger behind and up; it works.

s09.vista: The crest: a grey concrete block fills the left half of the frame, a grass bank the right. The steeple, a shed and the depot sit in the gap between them.
s09.discover: Side: the grass bank and a fir, nothing else.
s09.for: A crest should be a reveal (the rail yard, the way out). This one is a corridor between a block and a bank.

s10.vista: The rail shed's long wall on the left, the water tower with its lamp on the rise ahead.
s10.discover: Side: the shed's open doors, lit inside. The best 'go in' of the walk.
s10.for: A discovery right on the way out: tempting with the clock running.

s11.vista: Open grass to a fence, a green lamp on a post, a small hut: the way out, plainly.
s11.discover: Side: the shed's red wall down a gravel track to more roofs.
s11.for: The last approach: the green lamp does its job.

s12.vista: Arriving the way you came, you face a rise with pines and a fence: no truck, no lamp, no road in frame.
s12.discover: Side: the rail shed and the depot's sheds in the mist, the green lamp beside them.
s12.for: It should be relief (I made it). Facing into the trees, it reads as a dead end.

notes: Muddy arrival (s05): the job's point is at the farmhouse's corner, with an empty slope beside it. The farm's best frame is 15 m earlier at the fork (s04); the job should be there, or the slope should have a subject.
A crest with no reveal (s09): the climb out of the Hollow ends between a concrete block and a grass bank. It's the walk's one rise and it shows nothing.
A rendezvous facing into trees (s12): the last stop of the first raid has no subject ahead. The way out should read as a place: the truck's road, a lamp, an opening.
A discovery facing away (s03): the shed by the track has its door round the back.
Dead stretch: none. Calm, arrival, threshold, tension, climb, discovery: the walk alternates. It has three 'nothing' moments, at the job, the crest and the end.

fixes.title: 1. The Old farm's arrival (s05)
fixes.what: The job's point was at the farmhouse's corner, with the door close on the right and an empty slope on the left. It's now 13 m back, in the yard at the fork (s04's frame), so the arrival is the farm's best view: the farmhouse square ahead, the barn's wall on the left. The stop moved with the job's point. The after is the new arrival, looking the way you came in.

fixes.title: 2. A crest with a view (s09)
fixes.what: The 'concrete block' that filled the crest's left half was a standing stone of the stone ring: the route walked through the ring's edge. The ring is now 10 m east, up the hill's flank, off the way. From the crest you see the steeple, the depot's sheds, the green lamp and the rail shed: the way out, revealed as you top the rise.

fixes.title: 3. A rendezvous with something in front of it (s12)
fixes.what: The rendezvous stood at the yard's far edge, so arriving you faced a rise with pines. It's now 20 m north, 11 m short of the yard's hut and still 8 m clear of it for the truck. Arriving, you face the hut and the gap in the fence beyond it, with the water tower and its lamp beside the gravel road to the right. The stop moved with the rendezvous. The after is the new arrival.
